bkt_parity_reference: admissible_source main RBF S, 200000 pairs, rank 64, step 0.05
resume_policy: Require identical configuration, numerical source hashes, runtime, input hashes and verified endpoints; no reuse of aggregate historical timings
kde_bandwidth: multivariate Silverman full covariance, recomputed at each RK4 stage
kde_score_evaluation: exact Gaussian pair interactions; no truncation or subsampling
boundary: componentwise projection at RK stages and completed steps, matching the existing A model
horizon_rule: shared per beta: round((8 / existing FD-201 lambda1) / 0.05) * 0.05, matching the existing BKT endpoint
hit_threshold_description: SW2 at a prespecified common checkpoint <= independent-target-pair reference mean + sample SD
timing: single-thread fitting and sampling compute measured separately; metric callbacks, input loading and shared data generation excluded and reported separately; B drift fit charged to both B and D
data_budget_interpretation: same available stationary trajectory-pair pool; each retained method fits from all 200000 pairs; no minimum-data search
failure_policy: record nonfinite or failed runs; no seed selection, parameter tuning or replacement; do not silently aggregate successful subsets
